notes.title: Definitive Edition + Console News!
notes.notes:
Ecchi Sketch is heading to consoles! Platforms TBA, and more info soon!

Currently Steam has the most definitive version of Ecchi Sketch available, and new content will be added to go along with the new console releases!

Expect more dates with individual characters, find out what happens after the story in a host of cute new scenes with all new artwork!

I look forward to sharing more over the coming months!

notes.title: Ecchi Sketch Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

FINALLY, the bonus content is here! This will be uploaded and set live in the next couple of hours.

If you have anything installed on top of the base release, your game will break! Please update any additional files as necessary.

New features - 

Additional VA for Kyoko
Addition of bonus scene
Gallery feature

Thanks everyone!  If you enjoyed the patch, please visit me over at patreon.com/NewWestGames to help with future bonus content!
